scores.notes: Daniel steps up out of the round stone den on ropes hauled by two men, calm lions below, the glad king in purple with open arms at right; no marks, paint runs to every edge.
Night storm; Jesus asleep with his head on a rolled cushion in the stern while two disciples shake him awake, others at the mast and bailing; no lettering, hands sound.

Holmes with pipe and lens before the corner pawnbroker's (four gilt balls, blank board) by the railed weedy enclosure. Faint glyph-like ghost marks on the panel under the shop window and in a pane; white paper at left/right edges (accepted). Holmes's gaunt face with receding swept-back hair reads as Peter Cushing (moderate confidence).
Saul seated flings a spear at David, who dodges along the wall; a second spear already stuck in the cracked wall reads as the 'twice'. Harp and lamp present, no spirit figure, no lettering.
Jesus stands at the boat's end with hand raised toward the squall, sky clearing and water easing at right, disciples at mast and oars looking on; no marks, anatomy sound.

Moses with staff stretches his hand over the sea as the waters heap into walls and a sandy path opens, wind-bent trees, Israelites watching; no figure for God, no lettering (daylight rather than night is minor).
Bald Elisha in a hairy mantle walks the road up to the walled city while youths on both sides point and jeer; no bears yet, no lettering, hands fine.
Night courtyard: Jesus bound and led by guards at the left colonnade turns his head toward Peter, who clutches his chest by the fire at right; no lettering, anatomy sound.

Alice sits under a tree, flamingo laid down, looking up at the grinning Cheshire Cat; croquet ground with hedgehogs, card soldiers and shouting Queen behind. Lettering is only card pips and tiny corner index marks on the card soldiers; white paper at the edges (accepted). The Cat is a whole body on a bough rather than a head in the air, and hoops are wire, noted but not scored.
Daniel stands unharmed among four resting lions in the round pit, looking up to the king kneeling at the rim with a torch; a shaft of light only, no angel body; no lettering.

Caterpillar on the mushroom takes the hookah from its mouth, Alice mushroom-height beside it. The Caterpillar has a fully human old-man face and hands plus a bowler hat, not an animal head (talking-animal rule); small letter-like glyphs on the band of the hookah base.
Alice in the dark panelled hall of doors holds the little bottle up to inspect its paper label, which is blank; three-legged table with the gold key; no lettering, hands sound.

Tea table under the tree with Dormouse telling, March Hare pouring, Alice taking bread-and-butter. The Hatter has three hands (cup hand, raised pointing hand and a third holding bitten bread at his chest). Illegible squiggles on the hat price cards and small playing cards on the cloth.
Man with a knife stands over the lifeless woman laid on a bench, empty baskets waiting, household onlookers recoiling; restrained, no blood or dismemberment shown; no lettering.
Bank cellar: Holmes kneels with lantern and lens over the flagstones, Merryweather sulks on a crate in top hat, Watson stands by, open coin crate; no lettering, Holmes's face is generic.
Moses sits on a stone with Hur and Aaron (breastplate) each holding up one of his hands, battle below at sunset; hands checked at zoom and sound, no lettering.
Samuel pours the horn of oil over young David standing among his brothers, Jesse with staff, light rays from above (no human Spirit); no lettering, anatomy sound.

Moses on the stone at sunset above the battle with Aaron and Hur, but only one hand is raised (on the staff with Aaron); Hur holds the other wrist down on Moses's knee, so 'held up his hands' is only half shown. No lettering, anatomy acceptable.

Croquet ground with Alice hugging her flamingo, hedgehogs, card soldiers doubled into arches and the Queen shouting. Several Alice lookalikes appear at once (blue-dress girl with pinafore and flamingo at left, running girls mid-ground), reading as duplicates of her. Lettering is card pips and tiny index glyphs; white paper at the top edge (accepted).
Ezekiel stands in the valley of dry bones with arm raised, speaking over them; pale painted sky, no figure for God, the board he holds is blank; no lettering.

Priest drops the bird's remains on the ash heap beside the court curtain with the tabernacle at right, but a second, smaller tabernacle court stands at left with four giant robed figures as tall as the tent: duplicated place and contradictory scale. No lettering, God not drawn.

The picture is the letter's author himself, a Paul-like teacher with scrolls at his belt standing and addressing seated villagers: the narrator drawn as the subject. White paper at the edges (accepted); no lettering, anatomy sound.
Alice in the wood looks up, timid, at the grinning Cheshire Cat with long claws and many teeth on a bough; no lettering, paint to the edges.
An elder in a red cloak sets a stone on the wall scaffold with workers carrying baskets and mortar, Jerusalem behind: wall repairs as stated; no lettering, anatomy sound.

Pillar of cloud rests on the tabernacle amid the tent camp with people at camp chores; no figure in the cloud, no lettering. Some figures coil ropes and load a cart, which leans toward departure, but the camp stands.

Eyford platform: station-master points to the smoke column behind the trees as the train steams off, Bradstreet, Holmes, Watson and the bandaged engineer listening. Faint illegible marks on the papers of the station notice board (and hatch strokes at lower right); Holmes's small face is gaunt but not clearly any actor.

Tea party with Alice helping herself to bread-and-butter, Dormouse telling, Hatter with watch, March Hare pouring. Illegible marks on the Hatter's hat card and squiggles on the hats, watch-dial ticks; white paper along the right edge (accepted); hands sound.

Alice bends over a wooden croquet mallet fused with a flamingo, although the mallets are the flamingoes, with a second flamingo lying nearby; the Cheshire Cat floats as a whole body, not just a head. Lettering is only diamond pips on a tiny card soldier; pale unpainted paper at top/left (accepted).
Ezekiel among the dry bones with arm raised under the sun; the tablet he holds is blank at zoom, no figure for God; white paper at left/right edges (accepted).
David with sling faces Goliath pitching head-first to the ground between the two armies; no blood, no lettering, limbs sound. White paper around the edges (accepted).

Shows the letter's author, a Paul-like elder with a scroll, seated teaching listeners at a stone table in a Greek city: no mirror, dim reflection or face-to-face seeing is pictured. Faint squiggle lines on the open scroll on the table; pale unpainted sky at the top edge (accepted).

Railway carriage: Holmes tosses the ball of papers up toward the rack, Watson opposite, papers strewn on the seats. Papers carry lines of pseudo-print (no real words); white paper at left/right edges (accepted). Holmes's profile (receding swept-back hair, hollow cheeks, thin mouth) reads as Peter Cushing (moderate confidence).

Court scene with the White Rabbit in spectacles holding the blank paper, King, Queen, Alice protesting, animal jury with blank slates. Lettering is only heart and spade pips and a tiny glyph on the flat card soldiers flanking the Knave; the Knave himself is a human boy in a heart tunic (noted, not scored). White at the top is a painted window, not paper.
Light bursts through dark cloud over the dark deep; no figure, face or body for God, no lettering, paint to all edges.

Seraphim hover above in the gold temple with Isaiah below, but each has only two (one perhaps four) wings, faces veiled with cloth rather than wings and bare feet uncovered, against the text's six wings: visionary creatures do not follow the text. God shown only as light and cloud; wall reliefs carry no lettering.
Night: the round stone is hauled by ropes onto the den mouth while the kneeling king presents his signet and lords look on with torches; no lettering, paint to the edges, anatomy sound.

King in purple presses his signet into clay on the stone slab over the den while lords add their seals, guards around; no lettering on the seals. Odd wooden hatches beside the slab and daylight are minor.

Court scene with the White Rabbit in spectacles reading, King, Queen, bowed Knave and Alice standing. The Rabbit's paper is covered in cursive pseudo-script with a signature-like scrawl and loose sheets carry squiggles; the card soldiers are ordinary human men in pip tabards, not flat oblong cards (card rule).
David kneels at the brook choosing stones with sling in hand, pouch and shepherd's bag, staff laid beside him, Goliath and the armies distant; no lettering. White paper around the edges (accepted).

Lestrade leans aghast over the desk as seated Holmes studies the small paper, bag of clothes by them. Holmes's face (dark curls, long face, sharp cheekbones, cupid's-bow mouth) clearly reads as Benedict Cumberbatch, a screen-adaptation likeness. Papers show pseudo-print with a few numeral-like glyphs, and clock-dial ticks; white at the top is a painted window and picture mounts.

A frail ragged man is helped up the hill path under light breaking over the walled city, but the most prominent figure is a prophet with staff gesturing over him, the speaker of the oracle drawn into his own words. No lettering, anatomy sound.
